ios.desc:
Your Health, Your Way – Beautiful, Customizable Widgets for Home and Lock Screens.

Hidgets gives you complete control over how you view and track your Apple Health data. With unlimited customization, beautiful widget designs, and comprehensive health metric support, Hidgets transforms your iPhone into a powerful health dashboard.

UNLIMITED CUSTOMIZATION
• Choose from 6 stunning widget designs: Simple, Minimalist, Chart, Complete, Fitness, and Blood Pressure
• Customize colors, icons, and time periods for every widget
• Create unlimited widgets for different health metrics
• Mix and match styles to create your perfect health dashboard

20+ HEALTH METRICS
Track everything from Apple Health:
• Activity: Steps, Active Energy, Distance, Exercise Minutes, Stand Hours
• Body: Weight, BMI, Body Fat %, Lean Body Mass, Height
• Vitals: Heart Rate, Resting Heart Rate, Blood Pressure, Blood Oxygen, Body Temperature
• Fitness: Activity Rings, VO2 Max, Walking Heart Rate Average
• Sleep: Sleep Analysis with detailed charts
• And many more...

HOME & LOCK SCREEN WIDGETS
• System Small widgets for quick glances
• System Medium widgets for detailed data
• Lock Screen circular widgets (iOS 16+)
• Lock Screen rectangular widgets (iOS 16+)
• Always-available health data without unlocking

HIDGETS PRO FEATURES
Upgrade to unlock premium experiences:
• Chart Widgets - Beautiful data visualizations with 7-day trends
• Minimalist Widgets - Clean, elegant designs
• Complete Widgets - Detailed stats with progress tracking
• Fitness Widgets - Apple Activity Rings display
• Blood Pressure Widgets - Specialized BP monitoring
• All future premium features included

PRIVACY FIRST
• Direct Apple Health integration - your data stays on your device
• No third-party data sharing - ever
• No ads or tracking
• Read-only access to Health data
• Optional iCloud sync uses end-to-end encryption

PERFECT FOR
• Fitness enthusiasts tracking daily activity
• Health-conscious individuals monitoring vitals
• Weight management and body composition tracking
• Sleep quality improvement
• Chronic condition management (BP, heart rate)
• Anyone wanting quick access to health data

KEY FEATURES
• Unlimited widget creation
• 6 beautiful widget variants
• Home Screen and Lock Screen support
• 100+ SF Symbols icons to choose from
• Custom color themes and gradients
• Time period selection (today, week, month, year)
• Export widget previews as images
• Dark mode optimized
• Regular updates with new features

REQ
